PHP.1.3-6.text: Paul thanks God for the Philippians and their partnership

PHP.1.7-8.text: Paul says he loves the Philippians and they share in his grace

PHP.1.9-11.text: Paul prays that the Philippians’ love will grow

PHP.1.12-14.text: Paul’s chains help the gospel spread and make others bold

PHP.1.15-17.text: Some preach Christ from envy, others from love

PHP.1.18-19.text: Paul rejoices that Christ is preached and expects to be freed

PHP.1.20-20.text: Paul hopes to honor Christ by his life or his death

PHP.1.21-21.text: Paul says that for him to live is Christ and to die is gain

PHP.1.22-24.text: Paul is torn between dying to be with Christ and staying

PHP.1.25-26.text: Paul is sure he will stay to help the Philippians’ joy

PHP.1.27-27.text: Paul tells the Philippians to live worthy of the gospel

PHP.1.28-30.text: Paul tells the Philippians not to fear those who oppose them

PHP.2.1-2.text: Paul asks the Philippians to be united in love and purpose

PHP.2.3-4.text: Paul tells the Philippians to be humble and care for others

PHP.2.5-8.text: Christ humbled himself and obeyed even to death on a cross

PHP.2.9-11.text: God raises Christ high, and all will say he is Lord

PHP.2.12-13.text: Paul tells the Philippians to obey, because God works in them

PHP.2.14-16.text: Paul tells the Philippians to live without complaining, as lights

PHP.2.17-18.text: Paul rejoices even if he dies, and asks them to rejoice too

PHP.2.19-21.text: Paul hopes to send Timothy, who truly cares for them

PHP.2.22-24.text: Paul praises Timothy’s service and hopes to come soon

PHP.2.25-27.text: Paul will send Epaphroditus back; God healed him from near death

PHP.2.28-30.text: Paul asks the Philippians to welcome and honor Epaphroditus

PHP.3.1-3.text: Paul warns the Philippians against those who trust in the flesh

PHP.3.4-5.text: Paul lists his own reasons for confidence in the flesh

PHP.3.6-7.text: Paul counts his gains as loss for the sake of Christ

PHP.3.8-11.text: Paul counts all things as loss to know Christ and his power

PHP.3.12-14.text: Paul says he has not arrived but presses on toward the goal

PHP.3.15-16.text: Paul tells mature believers to hold this view and live by it

PHP.3.17-19.text: Paul tells the Philippians to follow his example, not the enemies of the cross

PHP.3.20-21.text: Believers are citizens of heaven; Christ will change their bodies

PHP.4.1-3.text: Paul urges the Philippians to stand firm and asks two women to agree

PHP.4.4-7.text: Paul tells the Philippians to rejoice, pray, and not worry

PHP.4.8-9.text: Paul tells the Philippians to think on good things and follow his example

PHP.4.10-13.text: Paul thanks the Philippians and says he is content in Christ

PHP.4.14-17.text: Paul thanks the Philippians for sharing in his needs

PHP.4.18-20.text: Paul says he has enough and God will supply the Philippians’ needs
